cohort: Live-born singleton children born to mothers with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark between 1995 and 2016.
finding: Preterm birth in children of mothers with IBD was significantly associated with an increased risk of mental retardation/intellectual disabilities (aHR 2.15; 95% CI 1.07-4.36).
gest_age: Preterm and full-term (specific gestational age cut-offs not stated)
